body:
User asked (verbatim): "just add to ask task we will check later"

Context: after the hard-wire audit (all 87 findings fixed, commit a57327b), three behaviours are documented as unverified at run time:
- fshttp InlinePDF (PublicOptions/SignedOptions.InlinePDF, CSP default-src none; object-src self): check Chrome, Safari and Firefox show a PDF inline and that every other type keeps the sandbox.
- adapters/cloudinary ResourceType image/video: a read sends format=<ext>; check what Cloudinary returns for a real upload (exact bytes or a conversion).
- adapters/azure Config.AccountName (I32): user-delegation SAS links through a custom domain, Front Door or private-endpoint DNS; Azurite cannot show it.

Acceptance: each checked against a real browser or account, findings written into the matching docs page (remove the "unverified" notes or fix the code).
title: Verify live: inline PDF in browsers, Cloudinary image/video formats, Azure signing behind a front end
